description: Reads what a language still needs, for one page or one CMS collection. page: the page is rendered in that language in a real browser and every translatable text on it comes back as { text, translation }, translation null where it is missing; text is the key to send back to set_translations unchanged. collection: the items of a translatable collection with each translatable field's default value and whether it is translated, and each item's translation state (missing, draft or published) and translated slug. Give page or collection, not both. Long lists come in parts: pass the answer's next as from. Translate only when the user asks for it (a Translate with your AI request, or their own words); never on your own while building or editing. Reads only.

branch.description: Optional branch; default the branch the workspace has open

from.description: For long lists: the `next` value of the previous answer

locale.description: A language code from list_locales (not the default language)

missingOnly.description: true: only texts or items that still need a translation. Default false: everything, with null where one is missing

page.description: The page's path in the default language, as list_pages shows it ("/", "/pricing"); without the language prefix

name: get_translations
title: Get translations
